title: Buddy Bolden's singing and when Punch came to town
summary: Zango mentions Bolden singing; Punch notes he arrived in 1919 after Bolden was gone.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: They say Buddy Bolden used to sing a lot of those. Yeah. He kind of read the whole thing.
You know, I never did know him, was that funny?
Well I mean. He didn't get to town until 1919.
Well when did he get away from me? I don't know. I died.
In 1906. Well I couldn't know him. No. You don't have to worry about that.
